title: Psychoneuroimmunology healing three-body
summary: Myss's healing frame grounded in psychoneuroimmunology: physical treatment, emotional healing and spiritual transformation coordinate through immune function. Meaning and lower stress strengthen immunity, which supports recovery, which in turn supports emotional work: a virtuous cycle that chronic stress runs in reverse.
source: Ch04 — "Healing as Coordination, Not Just Treatment" (Myss / PNI)

nodes.label: Durable Healing
nodes.description: Lasting recovery rather than absence of symptoms

nodes.label: Immune Function
nodes.description: Immune regulation affected by stress hormones and meaning

edges.description: Treatment works better in a body that can heal
A robust immune system supports lasting recovery
Less chronic stress means less immune suppression
Meaning and purpose reduce stress and boost immunity
A body less burdened by illness allows deeper psychological work

identifiability_note: Emotional and spiritual states are measured with noise and co-vary with treatment adherence, so mediation through immune function is confounded in observational data.
